text: In recognition of the urgent need to expedite efforts to transform Toronto’s housing system, this report provides the CreateTO Board of Directors with a broad update of 2025 housing-related work items: Priority housing sites, with proponents and equity confirmed (6 sites) Housing sites with secured proponents (2 sites) Housing sites that are zoned and tracking to market calls/securing a proponent (9 sites) Housing sites in market (none currently) Housing sites tracking to final zoning (4 sites) Update - Portfolio Wide Risk Factors
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Received the report (April 4, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO for information.
